answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 20 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in plume, checked in haven, and nebula publishes each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 1055 identities would post 3690 proofs and burn roughly 65 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
